name: print-social-design-is-a-solution-poster-navy-with-organic-cutouts
title: 'Design Is A Solution To A Problem' poster with navy background, organic cut-out shapes and a greyscale designer photo
whatItIs: A navy A4 poster with bold white headline 'Design is A Solution to A Problem', scattered flat organic shapes in pink, purple and orange around the edges, a greyscale photo of a man reviewing print samples at his desk, a pink 'We Think & Design' tagline, and social icons.
whatItMeans: Confident and philosophical; stating a design principle as the headline positions the studio as thoughtful, not just decorative.
techniques: Lead with a stated design philosophy as the headline.
Frame a greyscale work photo with colourful cut-out shapes.
Keep shape placement asymmetric for energy.

vocabulary.definition: A stated belief guiding a studio's creative approach.
Elements arranged unevenly rather than in a mirrored balance.
